purpose: Corrected QA audit before wiring PixelLab base/transition assets into the renderer

summary.correction: Previous audit was wrong because it inspected deflated PNG rows without applying PNG row filters. Correct unfiltering shows the sampled 32x32 RGBA PNGs are fully opaque.
summary.finding: Swamp base Wang and tile variants are usable as opaque foundational base tiles. Transition families still require visual/mask QA before broad integration.

nextAction: Renderer now uses swamp wet_mud/mud_pool Wang-15 tiles as the foundational base for swamp top surfaces. Next integration step is neighbor-aware use of wang_0..15 masks and visual QA of transition families.
